layouts.landing: Top nav (Logo + Auth links), Hero section (Left text, right image), extremely generous spacing (py-24 or py-32).
layouts.auth: Centered screen (min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center), off-white bg, white card with soft shadow.
layouts.dashboard: Two-pane layout. Left Sidebar (w-80) for Friends/Notifications. Main Content (flex-1) for Room Grid. Grid uses gap-6.
layouts.chat_room: Three-pane or Two-pane layout. Left: Optional Sidebar/Back. Middle: Chat History (flex-1, flex-col, overflow-y-auto). Right: Members list (w-72, hidden on mobile by default). Header fixed at top. Composer fixed at bottom.

components_instructions.buttons: Always use pill shape (rounded-full). Primary buttons use primary blue color. Secondary buttons use ghost or outline with slate text.
components_instructions.inputs: Rounded-2xl. Light border, no heavy focus rings, just a subtle primary blue focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30).
components_instructions.chat_bubbles: Sent messages align right, solid primary blue, white text. Received messages align left, white bg, dark text, subtle shadow. Use border-radius tricks for tails (e.g., rounded-3xl rounded-br-sm for sent).
components_instructions.cards: White background, large border radius (rounded-3xl), soft shadow. No heavy borders.
components_instructions.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog but customize to rounded-3xl.
components_instructions.dropdowns: Use Shadcn DropdownMenu for message actions (edit/delete) and member moderation.
components_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications (room invites, friend requests).
components_instructions.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (friendly, rounded stroke). Ensure consistent 20px size.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary blue has at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use focus-visible for keyboard navigation.

hero_image.description: Two women looking at a phone at an outdoor cafe, representing friendly connection.
hero_image.usage: Landing page hero image side-by-side with text.

mock_data_instructions: Create a robust set of mock static data in a separate file (e.g., data/mockData.js). Include currentUser, friendsList, notifications, activeRooms, and chatMessages. Implement placeholder functions like handleLogin(e), handleSendMessage(msg), handleKickUser(userId) that log to console or update local React state. Use standard React state hooks to make the UI feel alive and interactive even without a backend.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST use .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx
DO NOT use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Implement glass-morphism effects carefully; DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds where text exists over images/patterns.
Use pill-shaped or heavily rounded buttons with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Do NOT use emojis as icons.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and major layout sections.
Use Shadcn components as a base but heavily customize border-radius (rounded-3xl) to match the Telegram-friendly style.
